summary: Luzerne County, PA steel Aermotor tower built 1921, with a 1937 lookout posting; removed (1966 per Forest Lookouts, before 2005 per the register); no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Steel Aermotor tower with a cabin
facts.status_note: Removed: Forest Lookouts says 1966, the register says before 2005; no source we read describes the site today

events.note: Register says the steel Aermotor tower was built in 1921
April 1923 newspaper item reports a fourteen-year-old boy died while fighting a forest fire near the Humboldt tower; the item places the fire near Shellton, Schuylkill County
Foresters trying to find who was using the tower as a dog pen; dogs twice found in the cabin with food and water
Newspaper reports Peter Polega stationed at the Humboldt tower as a lookout for forest fires
Forest Lookouts lists 1966: Removed; the register says removed before 2005
Registered September 16, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts gives 1966 and the register says removed before 2005. The two agree, since 1966 is before 2005; the story uses 1966 and cites the register for the bound.

notes_for_editor: County conflict left open: the register and the Forest Lookouts heading say Luzerne County, while the April 1923 clipping places a fire near Shellton, Schuylkill County. The story says so and does not pick one. The 1923 clipping names a boy who died; the story and record leave the name out. The brief's record has no build year and no staffing; the register supplies 1921 and the Forest Lookouts page supplies 1937. Brief elevation 610.8 m matches the register's 611 m. No access information in either source, so access is left out. The 1937 staffing is one newspaper item, not a run of staffing records.
